name: Better Posters
description: Better Posters is a Jellyfin image fetcher for Movies and Shows that pulls configurable primary posters from btttr.cc.
overview: Fetch configurable Better Posters images from btttr.cc

versions.changelog:
### Changed
- Target Jellyfin 12.4 only. Jellyfin 10.11 and older are no longer supported.
- Rebuild the plugin against .NET 10 (`net10.0`) and the Jellyfin 12.4 packages.

### Changed
- Move Better Posters updates to the official GitHub project; replace the old Jellyfin update source and reinstall the plugin to keep receiving releases.

### Changed
- Moved the plugin repository to a new home. Reinstall Better Posters with the updated repository URL to keep receiving updates.
